patch_description: Revert to the efficient single-block CZ structure from the first prior program, but introduce even-odd partitioning for RY rotations. This splits the shared RY parameter into two: "ry_even" for qubits 0,2,4,6 and "ry_odd" for qubits 1,3,5,7. This maintains strong parameter economy (3 params vs 20) while granting selective flexibility that may capture parity-based patterns in the data. The gate count stays at 186 with only 3 unique parameters, yielding ~62 gates per parameter—excellent efficiency while testing if parity structure improves accuracy or convergence on the small training set.
